findings.summary: Digest concatenates path and bytes without length prefixes; two different content pairs on the same paths collide (verified computationally).
findings.failure_scenario: Bytes redistributed between kernel.md and plugin.json keep contract_digest constant while kernel.md changes.

findings.summary: write overwrites a later-station pin with an earlier one, no monotonicity check.
findings.failure_scenario: A retried earlier step rewinds the pin; merged check then fails or tooling reads a regressed batch.

findings.summary: cmd_write never reads the existing pin, so write --station <earlier> over a later-station pin silently regresses the chain (verified: merged then accepted both exit 0).
findings.failure_scenario: A rerun of an earlier station's write rewinds the pin; downstream checks read a valid-looking wrong lineage.

findings.summary: No test covers write overwriting an existing pin with an earlier station.
findings.failure_scenario: The write/overwrite contract is unverified either way.
